Enhance README with download info and installation steps

Added download section with latest release link and system requirements. Updated installation instructions and screenshot paths.

Fix Arc import to handle null titles and URLs gracefully

Changes to Arc data models:
- Make ArcSpace.title optional (Arc can have spaces with null titles)
- Make ArcTabData.savedTitle and savedURL optional (Arc can have links with null values)

Changes to import logic:
- Use "Untitled" fallback for null workspace titles with proper duplicate handling
- Use "Untitled" fallback for null link titles
- Skip links with null or invalid URLs instead of failing entire import
- Improve URL validation to check for nil before emptiness

This fixes the issue where a single link with savedTitle: null would cause
the entire items array decode to fail silently (via try?), leading to
noDataContainer error and blocking import of all bookmarks.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add comprehensive tests for Arc import null field handling

Test coverage:
- testSpaceWithNullTitle: Verifies workspaces with null titles use "Untitled"
- testLinkWithNullSavedTitle: Verifies links with null titles use "Untitled"
- testLinkWithNullSavedURL: Verifies links with null URLs are skipped
- testFolderWithNullTitle: Verifies folders with null titles use "Untitled Folder"
- testMultipleItemsWithMixedNullFields: Complex scenario with mixed valid/null data
- testUserFileWithNullSavedTitle: Regression test simulating the exact user issue
- testRealUserFile: Integration test with actual user file (if present)

These tests prevent regression of the bug where a single null field would
cause silent decode failure and block the entire import with noDataContainer error.

Verified with user's actual file: Successfully imports 5 workspaces, 867 links,
and 113 folders (previously failed with noDataContainer).

fix: use childrenIds traversal for Arc import hierarchy building (#24)

Arc's canonical parent-child relationships are stored in childrenIds,
not parentID. The old code relied solely on parentID filtering, which
missed children whose parentID pointed to the container instead of
their actual parent folder — resulting in empty imports.

Now uses childrenIds when the parent item exists in the items map,
with parentID fallback for root-level containers. Deduplicates items
claimed by folders to prevent them appearing both at root and nested.

fix: move EdDSA signing after notarization stapling to ensure signature matches final DMG (#25)

The notarization stapling process modifies the DMG file in-place by adding
a ~2KB notarization ticket. Previously, EdDSA signing happened before stapling,
causing a mismatch between the signature/length in appcast.xml and the actual
downloaded file. Sparkle would reject updates with 'EdDSA signature does not
match' errors.

This reorders the operations so EdDSA signing happens after stapling, ensuring
the signature and file length recorded in the appcast match the final DMG that
users download.

Fixes signature verification failures on client-side Sparkle update checks.

fix: support multi-window attachment for same browser app (#29)

Implement window focus tracking at the application level to detect when users switch between windows within the same browser (e.g., Chrome). Previously, Arcmark only attached to the window that was frontmost when the browser first activated, and switching to a different browser window wouldn't update the attachment.

Changes:
- Add app-level AX observer (kAXFocusedWindowChangedNotification) to detect window switches within the same browser app
- Use kAXFocusedWindowAttribute to directly get the focused window instead of relying on z-order
- Separate app observer lifecycle from window observer lifecycle—app observer persists across window switches
- Bring Arcmark window to front when attaching to a new browser window to match its z-order

Co-authored-by: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: restore window size and position on relaunch (#30)

Fixed window size persistence by:
1. Removing the conflicting setFrameAutosaveName mechanism that was competing with manual saves
2. Moving frame restore to after contentViewController is set, preventing layout-driven resizes from overriding saved frames
3. Saving/restoring full NSRect (position + size) instead of just NSSize
4. Guarding windowDidResize and applicationWillTerminate against attachment mode, preventing attachment resizes from overwriting manual size preferences

Attachment mode now preserves the last manual frame and restores it when disabled.

Co-authored-by: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: re-register window observers and skip cleanup for profile-spawned processes (#32)

Handle cases where window observers were cleaned up by re-registering them when needed. Skip cleanup if browser process is still running to handle short-lived instances spawned when opening URLs with browser profiles.

fix: support Firefox multi-profile window attachment (#33)

Firefox runs separate profiles as distinct OS processes (different PIDs) with
the same bundle identifier. The existing code assumed one process per bundle ID,
causing Arcmark to hide when switching between Firefox profiles.

Three issues fixed:
1. findFrontmostBrowserWindow() now filters by both bundleId AND isActive to
   find the correct active Firefox process instead of always returning the
   first-launched one
2. observeAppWindowChanges() detects PID changes and recreates the AX observer
   for the new process when switching profiles
3. Thread the verified frontmost app through attachToBrowser() to avoid
   re-discovery and ensure the observer is bound to the correct PID

Multi-window attachment for Chrome and single-profile Firefox are unchanged.

Fix note editor resource lookup crash (#63)

* fix(notes): resolve editor resources without trapping Bundle.module

Swift Bundler injects a custom `Bundle.module` accessor that calls
`fatalError` when its two hardcoded search paths (the app root and a
developer `.build` path) miss. The resource bundle actually ships under
`Contents/Resources`, so every external install of 0.1.12 trapped at
launch the instant `NoteServer`'s `Bundle.module.resourceURL` default
argument was evaluated in `applicationDidFinishLaunching`. The crash was
masked on the developer's own machine only because a stale `.build` tree
satisfied the hardcoded path.

Replace the eager, trapping default with `resolveBundledResourcesURL()`,
which searches the real locations (main bundle resources, executable dir,
and the code bundle for test/dynamic builds) and returns `nil` on miss.
A missing bundle now degrades gracefully to "editor unavailable" (the
server already 404s/500s) instead of killing launch.

Back up data.json before writes (#64)

* feat(datastore): back up data.json once per session before first write

Before this process first reads or writes data.json, copy it into a new
Backups/ directory under Application Support. The backup is latched to
once per session, skipped when byte-identical to the newest existing
backup (so relaunches don't rotate away the last good copy), and pruned
to the 10 most recent. Filenames use fixed-width UTC millisecond
timestamps so lexicographic sort equals chronological sort.

Hooked into both load() (before decode, preserving the file exactly as
the previous app version left it) and save() (so the no-write-before-
backup invariant holds regardless of AppModel call order).

* fix(datastore): stop overwriting data.json on decode failure

Previously a decode failure (corruption, or a downgrade hitting an
unknown Node case) caused load() to write defaultState() over the
user's real data — unrecoverable data loss. Now the error is logged and
the default state is returned in memory only, leaving data.json
untouched on disk; re-upgrading recovers everything with zero steps.

Includes a regression test: a corrupt data.json survives load() byte-
for-byte, with a matching pre-decode backup.
